snippet.title: Breadskate Forever - Speedrun All Levels - 10:47:25
snippet.description:
Speedrun of Breadskate Forever developed by sirmilkman on PC in All Levels category in 10:47:25

The run shows all 40 levels completed. There are a few hesitations and mistakes as I began to learn speedrunning this game today, but I think the sub 10 minutes is reachable!

I haven't found any other speedrun records on this game as it was released not long ago, so I guess it's a WR for now?

The game is available for free on itch io : https://sirmilkman.itch.io/breadskate-forever
